name: BUNKER APARTMENT INTERIOR
text: A compact living space carved out of old
concrete. It looks snug, packed with the
necessities for survival and a few comforts to
make it home.

name: WORKBENCH WITH DRONE
text: A sturdy wooden workbench strewn with gears,
tools, and schematics. In the center sits a
partially dismantled quadcopter drone, its
internal circuits exposed for repair.

name: DOUBLE BED
text: A wooden bedframe holding a mattress covered
in a colorful, patchwork quilt. The pillows
look slightly flattened from use.

name: KITCHEN COUNTER AND SINK
text: A wooden countertop featuring a built-in metal
sink filled with clean dishes drying on a
rack. An electric kettle rests nearby, plugged
in and ready.

name: SINGLE BED
text: A narrow wooden bed tucked into the corner,
dressed with a patchwork quilt similar to the
larger bed. It looks neatly made.

name: METAL WALKWAY RAILING
text: A sturdy metal railing running along the edge
of the exterior walkway. The paint is worn
from years of gripping hands.

name: EXTERIOR WALKWAY RAILING
text: A metal safety railing defining the edge of
the path outside the apartment. The concrete
below it looks weathered and stained.

name: LEFT BALCONY RAILING
text: A section of metal railing guarding the
walkway just outside the door. The concrete
floor beneath it is shadowed and scuffed.

name: RIGHT BALCONY RAILING
text: The metal safety barrier bordering the walkway
outside. The dull grey concrete is illuminated
by a faint light source nearby.

name: KITCHEN SHELF
text: A simple wooden shelf mounted above the
counter. It holds a small potted plant and
three neatly arranged storage jars.

name: GAS STOVE AND OVEN
text: A compact four-burner stove sitting next to
the counter. A metal kettle rests on one of
the grates, ready to be heated.

name: WOODEN BED HEADBOARD
text: The solid wooden headboard of the single bed.
A tiny potted plant sits perched precariously
on its top edge.

name: WOODEN BED HEADBOARD
text: The slatted wooden headboard of the double
bed, showing signs of wear and age. A single
white pillow is propped against it.

name: EXTERIOR VENTILATION UNIT
text: A boxy metal air conditioning or ventilation
unit sitting on the walkway outside. Rusty
pipes connect it to the main structure.
